before.reason: User rejected visual similarity. Direct inspection confirms narrow central fuselage, thin wings, narrow canopy, missing prominent framed side recesses and twin dark rear pods, upright rectangular fins.

criteria: Broad blended red central body and pointed ivory-cheek nose
Long wide amber-gold canopy with dark interior and gold frame
Cranked pointed main wings with substantial ivory outer panels and narrow gold edge
Visible dark side recesses in angular gold frames and separate twin charcoal rear pods
Tall swept canted fins with red ivory and gold panels
Whole craft readable in matching front three-quarter view on both variants and mobile
limits: Visual judgments are qualitative observations, not an automated similarity score.
Generated reference views contain inconsistencies; the hero three-quarter and top silhouettes set the visual target.
Geometry validity and browser operation are separate from visual acceptance.
